# Heaps

> Heaps is a cross-platform 2D/3D game engine written in Haxe (targets: HashLink with SDL/OpenGL or DirectX, and JavaScript/WebGL). Packages: `h2d` (2D scene graph), `h3d` (3D engine, GPU abstraction), `hxd` (resources, input, system, sound), `hxsl` (Haxe shader language).

Each link points to a Markdown page with the full public API of a type: signatures, documentation, inheritance and platform availability. File dependency map: [deps/DEPENDENCIES.md](deps/DEPENDENCIES.md).

## h2d

- [h2d.Align](api/md/h2d/Align.md): `Text` alignment rules.
- [h2d.Anim](api/md/h2d/Anim.md): Displays an animated sequence of bitmap Tiles on the screen.
- [h2d.BasicElement](api/md/h2d/BasicElement.md): A simple `BatchElement` that provides primitive simulation of velocity, friction and gravity.
- [h2d.BatchElement](api/md/h2d/BatchElement.md): A base class for `SpriteBatch` elements which can be extended with custom logic.
- [h2d.Bitmap](api/md/h2d/Bitmap.md): Displays a single bitmap Tile on the screen.
- [h2d.BlendMode](api/md/h2d/BlendMode.md): The blending rules when rendering a Tile/Material.
- [h2d.Camera](api/md/h2d/Camera.md): A 2D camera representation attached to `h2d.Scene`.
- [h2d.CdbLevel](api/md/h2d/CdbLevel.md): A decoder and renderer for levels created with the CastleDB 2D level editor.
- [h2d.CheckBox](api/md/h2d/CheckBox.md): A simple Interactive checkbox button with a label.
- [h2d.Console](api/md/h2d/Console.md): A simple debug console integration.
- [h2d.ConsoleArg](api/md/h2d/ConsoleArg.md): The console argument type.
- [h2d.ConsoleArgDesc](api/md/h2d/ConsoleArgDesc.md): A descriptor for an argument of a console command.
- [h2d.Drawable](api/md/h2d/Drawable.md): A base class for all 2D objects that will draw something on the screen.
- [h2d.Dropdown](api/md/h2d/Dropdown.md): A simple UI component that creates an interactive drop-down list.
- [h2d.Flow](api/md/h2d/Flow.md): An automatic layout system.
- [h2d.FlowAlign](api/md/h2d/FlowAlign.md): `Flow` content alignment rules.
- [h2d.FlowLayout](api/md/h2d/FlowLayout.md): The `Flow.layout` type.
- [h2d.FlowOverflow](api/md/h2d/FlowOverflow.md): The `Flow.overflow` rules.
- [h2d.FlowProperties](api/md/h2d/FlowProperties.md): An individual `Flow` element properties.
- [h2d.Font](api/md/h2d/Font.md): An instance of a text font.
- [h2d.FontChar](api/md/h2d/FontChar.md): A single `Font` character descriptor.
- [h2d.FontType](api/md/h2d/FontType.md): The rendering type of the of the `Font` instance.
- [h2d.Graphics](api/md/h2d/Graphics.md): A simple interface to draw arbitrary 2D geometry.
- [h2d.HtmlText](api/md/h2d/HtmlText.md): A simple HTML text renderer.
- [h2d.ImageVerticalAlign](api/md/h2d/ImageVerticalAlign.md): `HtmlText` img tag vertical alignment rules.
- [h2d.Interactive](api/md/h2d/Interactive.md): A user input handler.
- [h2d.Kerning](api/md/h2d/Kerning.md): A `FontChar` kerning information as well as linked list of kernings.
- [h2d.KeyFrames](api/md/h2d/KeyFrames.md): Adobe After effect player, see [Keyframes](https://github.com/heapsio/keyframes/) library.
- [h2d.KeyframesLayer](api/md/h2d/KeyframesLayer.md): [Keyframes](https://github.com/heapsio/keyframes/) integration; A `KeyFrames` animation layer.
- [h2d.LayerSpec](api/md/h2d/LayerSpec.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.Layers](api/md/h2d/Layers.md): A layer-based container for Objects.
- [h2d.LevelGroup](api/md/h2d/LevelGroup.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.LevelLayer](api/md/h2d/LevelLayer.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.LevelLayerData](api/md/h2d/LevelLayerData.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.LevelObject](api/md/h2d/LevelObject.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.LevelObjectInstance](api/md/h2d/LevelObjectInstance.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.LevelSpec](api/md/h2d/LevelSpec.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.LevelTileset](api/md/h2d/LevelTileset.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.LineHeightMode](api/md/h2d/LineHeightMode.md): The `HtmlText` line height calculation rules.
- [h2d.LoadingScene](api/md/h2d/LoadingScene.md)
- [h2d.Mask](api/md/h2d/Mask.md): Restricts rendering area within the `[width, height]` rectangle.
- [h2d.Object](api/md/h2d/Object.md): A base 2D class that all scene tree elements inherit from.
- [h2d.ObjectFollower](api/md/h2d/ObjectFollower.md): Follows the 3D object position in current 3D camera, synchronizing the follower position to projected 2D position of the followed object.
- [h2d.PartEmitMode](api/md/h2d/PartEmitMode.md): The particle emission pattern modes.
- [h2d.ParticleGroup](api/md/h2d/ParticleGroup.md): An emitter of a single particle group.
- [h2d.Particles](api/md/h2d/Particles.md): A 2D particle system with wide range of customizability.
- [h2d.RenderContext](api/md/h2d/RenderContext.md): A 2D scene renderer.
- [h2d.SDFChannel](api/md/h2d/SDFChannel.md): Channel reading method for `FontType.SignedDistanceField`.
- [h2d.ScaleGrid](api/md/h2d/ScaleGrid.md): A simple 9-slice bitmap renderer.
- [h2d.ScaleMode](api/md/h2d/ScaleMode.md): Scaling mode of the 2D Scene.
- [h2d.ScaleModeAlign](api/md/h2d/ScaleModeAlign.md): Viewport alignment when scaling mode supports it.
- [h2d.Scene](api/md/h2d/Scene.md): The root class for a 2D scene.
- [h2d.Scene3D](api/md/h2d/Scene3D.md)
- [h2d.Slider](api/md/h2d/Slider.md): A simple interactive horizontal numerical slider.
- [h2d.SpriteBatch](api/md/h2d/SpriteBatch.md): An active batched tile renderer.
- [h2d.Text](api/md/h2d/Text.md): A basic text renderer with multiline support.
- [h2d.TextInput](api/md/h2d/TextInput.md): A skinnable text input handler.
- [h2d.Tile](api/md/h2d/Tile.md): A core 2D rendering component representing a region of an underlying `h3d.mat.Texture`.
- [h2d.TileGroup](api/md/h2d/TileGroup.md): A static Tile batch renderer.
- [h2d.TileSpec](api/md/h2d/TileSpec.md): [CastleDB](http://castledb.org) integration; A part of `CdbLevel` decoder.
- [h2d.Video](api/md/h2d/Video.md): A video file playback Drawable.
- [h2d.ZGroup](api/md/h2d/ZGroup.md): An advanced double-pass rendering class that utilizes a z-culling on an opaque objects.
- [h2d.col.Bounds](api/md/h2d/col/Bounds.md): A 2D bounding box often used for determining Object bounding area.
- [h2d.col.Cell](api/md/h2d/col/Cell.md): The resulting cell inside the Voronoi diagram.
- [h2d.col.Circle](api/md/h2d/col/Circle.md): The circular hitbox implementation of a 2D Collider.
- [h2d.col.Collider](api/md/h2d/col/Collider.md): A common interface for 2D Shapes to hit-test again the mouse or a specific point in space.
- [h2d.col.Delaunay](api/md/h2d/col/Delaunay.md): A Delaunay triangulation utility.
- [h2d.col.DelaunayTriangle](api/md/h2d/col/DelaunayTriangle.md): The resulting triangle of a Delaunay triangulation operation.
- [h2d.col.Diagram](api/md/h2d/col/Diagram.md): The resulting diagram of the `Voronoi.compute`.
- [h2d.col.Edge](api/md/h2d/col/Edge.md): The resulting edge inside the Voronoi diagram.
- [h2d.col.Halfedge](api/md/h2d/col/Halfedge.md): The edge attached to a Voronoi `Cell`.
- [h2d.col.IBounds](api/md/h2d/col/IBounds.md): An integer-based bounding box.
- [h2d.col.IPoint](api/md/h2d/col/IPoint.md): An integer-based point.
- [h2d.col.IPolygon](api/md/h2d/col/IPolygon.md): An abstract around an Array of `IPoint`s that define a polygonal shape that can be collision-tested against.
- [h2d.col.IPolygons](api/md/h2d/col/IPolygons.md): An abstract over an Array of `IPolygon` instances that define multiple polygonal shapes that can be collision-tested against.
- [h2d.col.Line](api/md/h2d/col/Line.md): An infinite 2D line going through two specified Points.
- [h2d.col.Matrix](api/md/h2d/col/Matrix.md): An affine 2D 2x3 matrix.
- [h2d.col.OffsetKind](api/md/h2d/col/OffsetKind.md): The type of the edges when offsetting polygon with `IPolygon.offset`.
- [h2d.col.PixelsCollider](api/md/h2d/col/PixelsCollider.md): An `hxd.Pixels`-based collider.
- [h2d.col.Point](api/md/h2d/col/Point.md)
- [h2d.col.PointImpl](api/md/h2d/col/PointImpl.md): A simple 2D position/vector container.
- [h2d.col.Polygon](api/md/h2d/col/Polygon.md): An abstract around an Array of `Point`s that define a polygonal shape that can be collision-tested against.
- [h2d.col.PolygonCollider](api/md/h2d/col/PolygonCollider.md): A `Collider` wrapper around `Polygons` to enable using those for hit-testing testing.
- [h2d.col.Polygons](api/md/h2d/col/Polygons.md): An abstract over an Array of `Polygon` instances that define multiple polygonal shapes that can be collision-tested against.
- [h2d.col.Polynomial](api/md/h2d/col/Polynomial.md): See `Polynomial.regress`.
- [h2d.col.Ray](api/md/h2d/col/Ray.md): A raycast from the given position in a specified direction.
- [h2d.col.RoundRect](api/md/h2d/col/RoundRect.md): A Collider representing the rectangle with the rounded edges, forming a 2D capsule.
- [h2d.col.Segment](api/md/h2d/col/Segment.md): A 2D line segment.
- [h2d.col.Segments](api/md/h2d/col/Segments.md): An abstract over the list of `Segment`s.
- [h2d.col.Triangle](api/md/h2d/col/Triangle.md): A simple triangle collider.
- [h2d.col.Voronoi](api/md/h2d/col/Voronoi.md): A Steven Fortune's algorithm to compute Voronoi diagram from given set of Points and a bounding box.
- [h2d.filter.AbstractMask](api/md/h2d/filter/AbstractMask.md): A base class for filters that utilize separate Objects as a masking object.
- [h2d.filter.Ambient](api/md/h2d/filter/Ambient.md): A ColorMatrix filer that applies color correction depending on the masked area.
- [h2d.filter.Bloom](api/md/h2d/filter/Bloom.md): Applies a bloom effect to the filtered Object.
- [h2d.filter.Blur](api/md/h2d/filter/Blur.md): Utilizes the `h3d.pass.Blur` render pass to perform a blurring operation on the filtered object.
- [h2d.filter.ColorMatrix](api/md/h2d/filter/ColorMatrix.md): Applies a color correction filter based on the provided matrix.
- [h2d.filter.Displacement](api/md/h2d/filter/Displacement.md): Applies a normal map to the filtered Object in order to displace pixels.
- [h2d.filter.DropShadow](api/md/h2d/filter/DropShadow.md): Adds a soft shadow to the filtered Object.
- [h2d.filter.Filter](api/md/h2d/filter/Filter.md): The base filter class, you can extend it in order to define your own filters, although ShaderFilter will be the most straightforward way to define simple custom filter.
- [h2d.filter.Glow](api/md/h2d/filter/Glow.md): Adds a glow backdrop to the filtered Object.
- [h2d.filter.Group](api/md/h2d/filter/Group.md): Applies an array of Filters to a single Object with several limitations.
- [h2d.filter.InnerGlow](api/md/h2d/filter/InnerGlow.md): Adds a glow backdrop to the filtered Object.
- [h2d.filter.Mask](api/md/h2d/filter/Mask.md): Performs an arbitrary shape masking of the filtered Object.
- [h2d.filter.Nothing](api/md/h2d/filter/Nothing.md): A filter that renders nothing.
- [h2d.filter.Outline](api/md/h2d/filter/Outline.md): Provides a solid color outline to the filtered object by utilizing `h3d.pass.Outline` render pass.
- [h2d.filter.Shader](api/md/h2d/filter/Shader.md): The base class for simple filters that don't need specialized render passes and rely completely on the shaders.
- [h2d.filter.ToneMapping](api/md/h2d/filter/ToneMapping.md): Applies a color correction that emulates tonemapping.
- [h2d.impl.BatchDrawState](api/md/h2d/impl/BatchDrawState.md): Automates buffer segmentation when rendering 2D geometry with multiple unique textures.
- [h2d.impl.GenPointApi](api/md/h2d/impl/GenPointApi.md): A base common API interface for the points to validate API parity between 3D and 2D classes.
- [h2d.impl.IPointApi](api/md/h2d/impl/IPointApi.md): A common API interface for the integer Points to validate API parity between 3D and 2D classes.
- [h2d.impl.PointApi](api/md/h2d/impl/PointApi.md): A common API interface for the floating-point Points to validate API parity between 3D and 2D classes.

- [h3d.scene.AnimMeshBatch](api/md/h3d/scene/AnimMeshBatch.md): A `MeshBatch` whose instances all follow the animated transform of a source mesh (see `AnimMeshBatcher`).
- [h3d.scene.AnimMeshBatchShader](api/md/h3d/scene/AnimMeshBatchShader.md): Shader applying the animated transform of the source object to all the instances of an `AnimMeshBatch`.
- [h3d.scene.AnimMeshBatcher](api/md/h3d/scene/AnimMeshBatcher.md): Draws many copies of an animated object with instancing: one `MeshBatch` is created per mesh of the object, and all the copies play the same animation in sync.
- [h3d.scene.BaseSync](api/md/h3d/scene/BaseSync.md): Base class of the compute shaders updating the instance transforms on the GPU (see `Batcher.syncShader`).
- [h3d.scene.BatchData](api/md/h3d/scene/BatchData.md): The instance data of one material pass of a `MeshBatch`.
- [h3d.scene.BatchGroup](api/md/h3d/scene/BatchGroup.md): A group of instances of a `Batcher` which can be removed together.
- [h3d.scene.BatchLibrary](api/md/h3d/scene/BatchLibrary.md): The geometry storage shared by `Batcher` instances: the models are packed in one big primitive per vertex format.
- [h3d.scene.Batcher](api/md/h3d/scene/Batcher.md): A GPU driven renderer for very large numbers of static instances of many different models.
- [h3d.scene.BatcherFlags](api/md/h3d/scene/BatcherFlags.md): Options of a `Batcher`.
- [h3d.scene.Box](api/md/h3d/scene/Box.md): A debug wireframe box, drawn with 12 lines.
- [h3d.scene.CameraController](api/md/h3d/scene/CameraController.md): Base class of the mouse/keyboard camera controllers.
- [h3d.scene.Capsule](api/md/h3d/scene/Capsule.md): A debug wireframe capsule aligned on the X axis: a cylinder of `length` capped by two half spheres of `radius`.
- [h3d.scene.CpuIndirectCallBuffer](api/md/h3d/scene/CpuIndirectCallBuffer.md): The indirect draw commands of one material, built on the CPU when using sub meshes.
- [h3d.scene.DynamicJointData](api/md/h3d/scene/DynamicJointData.md): The runtime state of a dynamic joint (`h3d.anim.Skin.DynamicJoint`): a joint simulated as a spring following its animated position, for hair, cloth or other secondary motion.
- [h3d.scene.FPSCameraController](api/md/h3d/scene/FPSCameraController.md): A free flying "first person" camera controller: - right button drag: looks around; - while holding the right or middle button: arrow keys or ZQSD move forward/backward/sideways (W, S and D also work),   A moves down a...
- [h3d.scene.GPUMeshBatch](api/md/h3d/scene/GPUMeshBatch.md): A `MeshBatch` using GPU driven rendering: the level of detail selection and the frustum culling of each instance can be computed by a compute shader (see `enableGpuLod` and `enableGpuCulling`), and the instances are d...
- [h3d.scene.Graphics](api/md/h3d/scene/Graphics.md): Draws 3D lines with an API similar to `h2d.Graphics`: set a style with `lineStyle`, then `moveTo` / `lineTo`.
- [h3d.scene.HierarchicalWorld](api/md/h3d/scene/HierarchicalWorld.md): A streamed world split in a quadtree of square chunks on the XY plane.
- [h3d.scene.Interactive](api/md/h3d/scene/Interactive.md): A 3D object receiving mouse, touch and keyboard events through a collision shape.
- [h3d.scene.Joint](api/md/h3d/scene/Joint.md): A temporary object representing a joint (bone) of a `Skin`, returned by `Skin.getObjectByName`.
- [h3d.scene.JointData](api/md/h3d/scene/JointData.md): The runtime state of a joint of a `Skin` (one per joint of the skin data).
- [h3d.scene.Light](api/md/h3d/scene/Light.md): Base class for all 3D lights.
- [h3d.scene.LightSystem](api/md/h3d/scene/LightSystem.md): Base class of the lighting setup used by a `Renderer`.
- [h3d.scene.Mesh](api/md/h3d/scene/Mesh.md): h3d.scene.Mesh is the base class for all 3D objects displayed on screen.
- [h3d.scene.MeshBatch](api/md/h3d/scene/MeshBatch.md): h3d.scene.MeshBatch allows to draw multiple meshed in a single draw call.
- [h3d.scene.MeshBatchFlag](api/md/h3d/scene/MeshBatchFlag.md): Options of a `MeshBatch`, set with its `enable*` methods.
- [h3d.scene.MultiMaterial](api/md/h3d/scene/MultiMaterial.md): A `Mesh` using several materials, one per material group of its primitive.
- [h3d.scene.Object](api/md/h3d/scene/Object.md): h3d.scene.Object is the base 3D class that all scene tree elements inherit from.
- [h3d.scene.ObjectFlags](api/md/h3d/scene/ObjectFlags.md): Bit flags storing the boolean state of an `Object`.
- [h3d.scene.ObjectInstance](api/md/h3d/scene/ObjectInstance.md): A model registered in a `Batcher` with `Batcher.addInstance`, which can then be emitted many times.
- [h3d.scene.OptAlgorithm](api/md/h3d/scene/OptAlgorithm.md): Geometry optimizations available for `WorldModel.optimize`.
- [h3d.scene.OrbitCameraController](api/md/h3d/scene/OrbitCameraController.md): A camera controller orbiting around a target, as in 3D editors: - right button drag: pans the target; - middle button drag (or Alt + left button drag): rotates around the target; - mouse wheel: zooms (see `enableZoom`...
- [h3d.scene.PassObjects](api/md/h3d/scene/PassObjects.md): The list of draw passes emitted for one pass name (such as `"default"`, `"alpha"` or `"shadow"`) during a frame, handed to the `Renderer` by the `Scene`.
- [h3d.scene.RenderContext](api/md/h3d/scene/RenderContext.md): The per-frame state of a 3D `Scene` rendering, shared by the scene objects, the `Renderer` and the render passes.
- [h3d.scene.RenderMode](api/md/h3d/scene/RenderMode.md): The rendering mode of a `Renderer`.
- [h3d.scene.Renderer](api/md/h3d/scene/Renderer.md): Base class of the scene renderers.
- [h3d.scene.Scene](api/md/h3d/scene/Scene.md): h3d.scene.Scene is the root class for a 3D scene.
- [h3d.scene.Skin](api/md/h3d/scene/Skin.md): A skinned mesh: a mesh deformed by a skeleton of joints (bones), driven by skeletal animations.
- [h3d.scene.Sphere](api/md/h3d/scene/Sphere.md): A debug wireframe sphere, drawn as three orthogonal circles of 32 segments.
- [h3d.scene.SubMesh](api/md/h3d/scene/SubMesh.md): A part of the primitive of a `MeshBatch` which can be drawn by an instance (see `MeshBatch.primitiveSubMeshes`).
- [h3d.scene.SubPart](api/md/h3d/scene/SubPart.md): An index range of the primitive, for one material and its levels of detail.
- [h3d.scene.SubSkin](api/md/h3d/scene/SubSkin.md): A skin following the skeleton of another skin: the joints with the same name copy the pose of `baseSkin`.
- [h3d.scene.SyncShaderInterface](api/md/h3d/scene/SyncShaderInterface.md): The parameters of a `Batcher.syncShader`, filled by the batcher before running it.
- [h3d.scene.Trail](api/md/h3d/scene/Trail.md): A ribbon following the movements of the object, such as a sword or projectile trail.
- [h3d.scene.View](api/md/h3d/scene/View.md): A rendering view: the frustum used to cull objects for the current view (see `RenderContext.currentView`).
- [h3d.scene.World](api/md/h3d/scene/World.md): A static world made of many model instances, split in square chunks on the XY plane.
- [h3d.scene.WorldChunk](api/md/h3d/scene/WorldChunk.md): A square area of a `World`, of `World.chunkSize` units.
- [h3d.scene.WorldData](api/md/h3d/scene/WorldData.md): The parameters of a node of a `HierarchicalWorld`.
- [h3d.scene.WorldElement](api/md/h3d/scene/WorldElement.md): A model instance placed in a `World` chunk.
- [h3d.scene.WorldMaterial](api/md/h3d/scene/WorldMaterial.md): A material of a `World` model: the geometries sharing the same material bits are merged in the same mesh.
- [h3d.scene.WorldModel](api/md/h3d/scene/WorldModel.md): A model loaded by `World.loadModel`: its geometry is kept on the CPU to be merged into the chunks.
- [h3d.scene.WorldModelGeometry](api/md/h3d/scene/WorldModelGeometry.md): A part of a `WorldModel` using one material.
